what: Re-check of the A4 report's OPEN FINDING: 'negation's 0-false-admit is proven non-vacuous by nothing on the operating (dist-form) index'. Drives the SHIPPED semantic mutation-bench on a freshly rebuilt operating index at current master and reads the non-vacuity teeth directly. Judge-free: the label comes from the independent tsc oracle, no LLM anywhere.
why: BENCHMARKS.md (PR #258) published that open finding as a stated limit. This probe tests whether the limit is still true. It is NOT: the finding was closed by #192 (WP-C1, 2026-08-18), which re-anchored the teeth onto the leg that is load-bearing on a dist-form index. The A4 report (same date) predates that commit and was never amended.

environment.build_state: dist-form (tsc -b BEFORE the index) — the operating recipe

population.checkability_note: SUPERSEDED 2026-08-29 (later the same day): the bench now prints the raw numerator/denominator beside every percentage (packages/adapter-io/test/support/bench-scorer.ts carries falseAdmitNum/Den and recallNum/Den through; semantic-bench.test.ts prints them on every per-arm line and both negation diagnostic lines). The fractions above are therefore MEASURED, read off the run, not inferred. The earlier inference is preserved here because it was CONFIRMED exactly: this artifact previously derived 25/204 and 0/204 arithmetically from the rounded percentages, and the instrumented re-run printed 25/204 and 0/204. Recorded as evidence that the arithmetic was sound, not to claim inference is as good as measurement — it is not, which is why the instrument was changed.

headline.negation_door_falseAdmit: 0.00% == 0/204 (MEASURED — the bench now prints raw counts)
headline.negation_teeth_callersBlind_falseAdmit: 12.25% == 25/204 (MEASURED — the bench now prints raw counts)
headline.verdict: NON-VACUOUS. Blinding gate (c) (`reverseCallers` forced to []) — one leg of the byte-identical shipped door, nothing else touched — drives the negation false-admit from 0.00% to 12.25%. The shipped assertion `expect(teeth.negation.falseAdmit).toBeGreaterThan(s.negation.falseAdmit)` (semantic-bench.test.ts) is LIVE and GREEN, not the `expect(0).toBeGreaterThan(0)` the A4 report found.
headline.why_not_tautological: Blinding `reverseCallers` defeats ONLY gate (c), the final refutation step. Rows already abstained by gates (b0)/(b1)/(b2) (scope-open / escape-open / dynamic-reach) abstain identically under both doors, so a rise is NOT guaranteed by construction: if every FALSE row were caught upstream of gate (c) this teeth would legitimately measure 0 and the assertion would FAIL. It rises because gate (c) is the leg actually carrying the soundness on this index.

the_stale_leg.reading: The #99 collapsed-local opaque gate — the leg the A4 report probed — is NOT load-bearing on a dist-form index: `canonicalizeSymbol` resolves the cross-package refs instead of collapsing them onto opaque `local` symbols, so gate (c) refutes them first. It remains load-bearing on a dist-ABSENT index (where it measures 132/163 = 80.98%). The bench still measures and PRINTS this leg, labelled REPORTED-not-asserted.

secondary_finding_header_vs_proven.reading: These raw per-arm rates count EVERY admit, including the unsealed `justified` advisory tier. Since #210 (abstain ⇒ justified, never drop), a grounded claim the oracle cannot refute is admitted as an advisory BY DESIGN and carries no soundness claim. The soundness assertions range over the PROVEN-SEALED subset only (`d.proven`). Reading the raw header rate as a soundness number is a category error — the two tiers are measured differently by construction.
secondary_finding_header_vs_proven.proven_sealed_property_asserted_green: every one of the 369 is backed by a REAL in-scope tsc reference (the call-vs-reference oracle gap), i.e. 0 fabricated edges. This is the live mechanical form of the A4 report's one-time hand adjudication of 318 rows.

honesty: Scope of the teeth, as the test states it: it proves the 0 is earned for the rows the door decides by REFUTATION. Rows that abstain (scope-open / escape-open) are non-admitted for conservative reasons this mutation does not disturb; their contribution to the 0 is a refusal, not a proof. Both numbers are printed by the bench.
population_drift_vs_the_A4_report: The A4 report measured the negation FALSE pool at n=163 on rev 9eb4d7f (2026-08-17). This run measures 204 FALSE rows on rev b889db6 (2026-08-29) — the repo grew (targets 1333 -> 1534) and the planted pool grew with it. So BENCHMARKS.md's headline '0 / 163' is the A4 artifact's population, not this run's; the door's false-admit is 0 on BOTH (0/163 there, 0/204 here). Flagged so the two populations are not read as one.

instrumented_rerun.when: 2026-08-29, after the raw-count change landed on master (ae751ab)
instrumented_rerun.reading: Identical to the pre-instrumentation run in every figure. The instrument changed; the measurement did not.
